errors.evidence: The green line for 'Строителство' (Construction) increases from approximately 4.5 in 2011 to approximately 7 in 2012. The description incorrectly states that it decreases ('спада').
The value for 'Строителство' (Construction) in 2017 is approximately 30.5, not 17.
The markers for the blue line ('Промишленост') are diamond-shaped, not circular ('кръгови').
The value for 'Промишленост' (Industry) in 2011 is approximately 7.5, not 9.
The markers for the red line ('Търговия') are square-shaped, not triangular ('триъгълни').
The markers for the purple line ('Услуги') are X-shaped, not rectangular ('правоъгълни').
The purple line for 'Услуги' (Services) starts at a value of approximately 2 in 2011, not 7. The value 7 is closer to the starting point of the 'Промишленост' (Industry) line.
The purple line for 'Услуги' (Services) ends at a value of approximately 16.5 in 2017, not 26. The value 26 is closer to the end point of the 'Промишленост' (Industry) line.
